about.title: Korean Taste in Every Dish
storyText: Seoul Korean Cuisine was born from a passion to bring authentic Korean flavors closer to Vietnamese diners. We wanted to create a dining space where everyone can experience the true taste of Korea right here in Vietnam.
Our journey began with the search for traditional recipes, the highest-quality ingredients, and elegant, refined presentation — all to deliver the most wonderful experience for our customers.
philosophyItems: Fresh ingredients daily — no frozen food or preservatives
Traditional Korean recipes that preserve authentic local flavors
Imported meat, fresh seafood, and safe organic vegetables
Customize dishes to your taste: spice level, toppings, size, and sweetness
atmosphereText: The space at Seoul Korean Cuisine is designed in the "Modern Seoul after dark" style — modern and cozy, with deep charcoal black, warm gold, and rich Korean red tones. The warm golden lighting creates a relaxing feel, perfect for family dinners, romantic dates, or cheerful gatherings with friends.

Every detail — from the tables and chairs to the plates and food presentation — is carefully crafted to deliver a complete dining experience: not only delicious, but also beautiful and mentally relaxing.
